extDescription: Warns before the risky step: pasting a hidden command, entering a device code, approving an app or signing in on a fake page.
hold_hint: Press and hold the button until the bar fills up.
type_label: Or type the word {word} here and press Enter:
covered_warning: Something on this page is covering this warning, so the hold button is switched off. Close this tab if you are not sure.
clipboard_note: SafetyCatch removed a risky command that a web page copied. Nothing was run. You can copy your own text again now.
paste_title_hidden: This page secretly copied a command
paste_title_selection: The text you copied is a risky command
paste_tamper_title: This page wants you to paste a command
paste_unchecked_title: Copied text looks like a command
paste_lead_hidden: {site} put a command on your clipboard. If you paste it into the Run box, PowerShell or Terminal, strangers could take over your computer.
paste_lead_selection: You copied a command from {site}. If you paste it into the Run box, PowerShell or Terminal, strangers could take over your computer.
paste_tamper_lead: {site} shows steps for pasting something into the Run box or Terminal, and it tried to get around clipboard protection. We cleared your clipboard to be safe.
paste_unchecked_lead: SafetyCatch could not finish checking the text that {site} copied, but it looks like a command, so we removed it to be safe.
paste_cleared: We replaced it with a harmless note. Nothing bad happens if you paste now.
paste_not_cleared: We could not clear your clipboard. Do not paste anything yet. Press the button below to clear it.
paste_never: Real websites never ask you to paste a command to prove you are human, fix an error or open a file.
paste_sample_title: What was copied (shown safely, it cannot run from here)
paste_restore_hold: Hold to put the command back
paste_notice_text: The text you copied from {site} is a command that can change your computer. Paste it only if you know what it does and trust who wrote it.
unchecked_text: SafetyCatch could not check the text this page copied. Do not paste it into the Run box, PowerShell or Terminal unless you trust it.
login_title_brand: This may be a fake {brand} sign-in page
login_medium_title: Check the address before you sign in
login_lead_brand: This page asks for your password and looks like {brand}, but its address is {site}.
login_lead: This page asks for your password, but its address ({site}) has warning signs.
login_never: If you type your password here, strangers could get into your account.
login_banner_text: Do not type your password unless you are sure this is the right site.
login_stay_hold: Hold to stay and type anyway
device_title: Only enter a code here if you started this yourself
device_lead: This is a real {provider} page that connects a new device or app to your account. Scammers send people here with a code. If you enter their code, they get into your account without your password.
device_rule: Enter a code only if you just started signing in on your own TV, console or tool and it showed you the code. Never enter a code that someone sent you.
device_continue_hold: Hold: I started this on my own device
arrival_external: You came here from a link outside your browser, such as an email or chat message.
oauth_title: An app is asking for access to your {provider} account
oauth_lead: If you approve, the app keeps this access even after you change your password. Approve only if you chose to connect this app yourself.
oauth_continue_hold: Hold to go on to the approval page
scope_basic: See your name, email address and profile
lure_title: This page was written by an unknown person
lure_title_strong: Do not follow the steps on this page
lure_text: Anyone can publish a page on this service. It was not written or checked by the company named in the address. It tells you to paste or download something: do that only if you fully trust who sent you here.
ai_title: This text seems to contain secrets
ai_lead: The text you are pasting into this AI chat seems to contain private items ({count}).
ai_note: AI chats can store what you paste, and other people may be able to see it later.
ai_unchecked_text: SafetyCatch could not check the text you are pasting. It may contain passwords or keys.
dl_paused: We paused the download. Nothing has been opened.
dl_finished: The download already finished. The file has not been opened.
dl_done_cancelled: The download was cancelled. You can close this window.
dl_done_resumed: The download continues. Be careful before you open the file.
dl_done_deleted: The file was deleted. You can close this window.
dl_done_kept: The file was kept. Be careful before you open it.
dl_gone: This download is no longer waiting for a decision. You can close this window.
popup_trusted: You trusted {site}. Warnings are off here until {date}.
popup_trusted_forever: You trusted {site}. Warnings are off here.
popup_cannot: SafetyCatch cannot run on this page. Browser pages and extension stores are off limits to extensions.
mod_platformLure: Notice on pages anyone can publish
mod_aiPaste: Secrets check when pasting into AI chats
mod_pasteGuard_desc: Stops web pages from putting dangerous commands on your clipboard (fake CAPTCHA and fake error pages).
mod_authFlow_desc: Explains device-code pages and app-approval pages, and warns when you reached them from an email or another site.
mod_lookalike_desc: Warns before you type a password on a page that imitates a well-known brand.
mod_platformLure_desc: On shared AI chats, site builders and similar services, reminds you that the page was written by an unknown person.
mod_aiPaste_desc: Before text goes into an AI chat, checks it for passwords, keys, card and ID numbers and offers to hide them.
mod_downloads_desc: Pauses downloads that look disguised or dangerous and asks you first.
trust_warn: Only do this for sites you know well. All warnings are switched off on a trusted site.
status_error: SafetyCatch could not load its settings. Protection may be limited. Close and reopen the browser, then try again.
opt_ai_help: One site per line, for example chatgpt.com or huggingface.co/chat. Pasted text is checked for secrets on these sites.
opt_trust_help: Warnings are switched off on these sites. Write *.example.com to include every sub-site of example.com.
opt_trust_invalid: That is not a site name we can use.
opt_mt_note: This translation was made by a machine and still needs review by a native speaker.
opt_import_bad: That file is not a valid SafetyCatch settings file.
opt_stored_1: Your settings: which protections are on, your AI chat site list, your trusted sites and your language.
opt_stored_2: A list of the last {count} warnings: only the site name, the kind of warning, the rule names, the risk level and the time.
opt_stored_3: Never stored: page content, copied or pasted text, passwords, file contents or your browsing history.
opt_stored_4: Everything stays in this browser. Nothing is sent anywhere. There are no accounts and no tracking.
opt_stored_5: While the browser is open, SafetyCatch keeps the last few pages of each tab in memory only, to tell how you reached a sign-in page. This is erased when the tab or the browser closes.
